description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkService class, which provides methods for calculating and retrieving employee work time data, including weekly summaries, last actions, and detailed time calculations. It uses multiple traits and interacts with DAOs and other services to process attendance records and generate relevant reports.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing employee time tracking and attendance data, including weekly summaries, last punch actions, and detailed time calculations.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkResults
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves weekly data and metadata related to employee work time based on current and spot date-times.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkMetaData
methods.description: Generates metadata for the current work day and week, including last actions, total times, and user details.

methods.name: getDateDetails
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a date and label representation.

methods.name: getTimeInHoursAndMinutes
methods.description: Converts total minutes into hours and minutes format.

methods.name: getLastActionDetails
methods.description: Retrieves and formats details of the last attendance record action for an employee.

methods.name: getTotalTimeForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates total work time for an employee on a specific date based on attendance records.

methods.name: getDataForCurrentWeek
methods.description: Aggregates daily work time data for the current week for an employee.

methods.name: getTimeDifference
methods.description: Computes the difference in minutes between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: getDateTimeInUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getCurrentUserData
methods.description: Retrieves current user details based on employee number.

methods.name: getWeekStartDateIndex
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the index representing the start day of the work week.
